title: Rabbi Yose bar Gezira
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: At the end of Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot, Rabbi Yonah reports him: “All chatter is bad, but chatter about Torah is good.” The statement appears in Midrash Shmuel under Rabbi Yehoshua ben Gezira; see his entry.

notes.text: The consulted Berakhot paragraph confirms the contrast between ordinary chatter and Torah chatter; the earlier guess about a dish is withdrawn. The Yose/Yehoshua name variant remains Hyman’s comparison.
The consulted Yerushalmi has Yose ben Gezira. The consulted Midrash Shmuel has Yehoshua bar Gezura. The English retains the forms as Hyman gives them.
